items.summary: CRO product disposition: defer new fleet-control and AI-cost-control implementations. Existing admission, deduplication, measurement, retry, and AI-usage records already cover the proposed use cases, while delivery is saturated and active measurement work is consuming capacity. GitHub signals remain research-only: markitdown has MIT licensing and bounded lab checks, shadcn-ui/ui has MIT licensing and passed available checks, and mermaid is MIT-licensed with supported fit but no native checks. None has fleet-specific security, maintenance, integration, or revenue evidence sufficient for adoption. No prototype or queue admission this cycle.
